text_block_list.text: One day just before summer training camp—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: —Uooooooooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... *wheeze*... *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Heheh... Not even close yet...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —You're really fired up.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ikuno!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It seems her Turbo Engine is running in 
top gear today as well.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Turbo plans to enter the upcoming 
All Comers! So I'm totally fired up!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My goodness...! The truth is, I was 
actually planning on running in the All 
Comers too—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really!? Then that means you'll be 
racing Ikuno!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I can't wait~! Turbo's not gonna 
lose!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. I won't lose either.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Allllright, the fire in me is burning even 
hotter now!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo, blast oooooff--!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
“—And that's what happened. It seems 
Turbo-san is all fired up too.”
choice_data_list:
It really brings back memories, doesn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Running with Turbo-san... really gets 
my fire going too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to make the most of summer camp 
so I can face them as a stronger version 
of myself.

And so, Ikuno Dictus and I were able to 
tackle this year's summer training camp 
with high motivation, but—
...On the other hand.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Hurry.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I have to do something quickly, or else...

—There was no way for anyone to know of 
that prayer-like voice.
